message.content:
This is a rack-mounted server, which is an automatic data processing machine of heading 8471. It is not a portable machine and not a "system" presented as a keyboard-and-monitor unit. Subheading 8471.50 covers processing units other than those of 8471.41 or 8471.49, so it is the natural fit. The statistical suffix is 8471.50.0150 for "other processing units, other, digital," although 8471.50.0150 may carry a different description. The usual breakdown is:

- 8471.50.0150: Digital processing units, other than those of subheading 8471.41 or 8471.49, … other.
- 8471.50.0100 is not a valid suffix.

I am fairly confident about 8471.50.0150. CBP rulings on servers (for example, rulings on Dell PowerEdge servers) have classified them in 8471.50.0150.
